input.title: Dragging into sibling animates into wrong position
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- A
  - B
  - C
    - D
```

1. Set the cursor on `C`. 
2. Drag `B` into `C`, above `D`. 

## Current Behavior

`D` is rendered too low. If the cursor is moved, it corrects itself.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0605909a-7f45-4554-94f1-c4c62fc5e577)

## Expected Behavior

`D` should be rendered in the correct place immediately after drag-and-drop. 

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0ff3c57e-bc3f-4602-96ab-9b517da589dd)
